prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Master Your Pet Controls", "Try out summoning, hiding, and speaking with your pet right now before landing on your desktop.", "Test Pet Controls"]
1: ["Make sure your photo has bright lighting and clear facial features for the best custom pet result.", "Photo Quality Verification", "We are checking your photo for lighting and angle to ensure your custom pet looks perfect.", "Confirm & Generate Pet"]
2: ["Desktop Overlay Calibration & Pet Walkthrough", "Let's make sure your desktop pet is clearly visible and easy to summon anytime.", "Verify desktop overlay permission", "Test Pet Visibility"]
3: ["Save Your Pet Companion Account", "Sign in now to permanently link your chosen pet to your account and prevent pet resets.", "Signing in secures your pet across desktop sessions."]
4: ["Use the same email to sign in every time so your pet desktop progress and custom traits stay saved."]
5: ["Choose How to Create Your Desktop Companion", "Pick Instant Friend for ready-to-play pets or Custom Photo to generate a pet from your own image."]
6: ["Spawning Your Pet onto Desktop...", "We are preparing the desktop overlay layer. Make sure app permissions allow overlay display."]
7: ["Claim Your Official Desktop Pet Adoption Certificate", "Enter Pet Name", "Official Companion Certified"]
8: ["You will receive a notification as soon as your desktop pet is ready to emerge!"]
9: ["Essential Desktop Pet Controls", "Double-click pet to open interaction menu", "Right-click pet tray icon to minimize or hide", "Press Ctrl+Shift+P to summon pet to cursor"]
